
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Marktowin/p/19525635" title="发布于 2026-01-24 11:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">访问控制权限模型的分析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3 dir="auto">1. 概述</h3>
<p dir="auto">权限模型（Access Control Models）是信息安全领域用于管理资源访问的核心机制。它们定义了谁（主体）可以对什么（客体）进行哪些操作（如读、写、执行）。常见的模型包括DAC、MAC、RBAC、ABAC等。这些模型可单独使用或组合（如RBAC与ABAC的混合）。选择模型取决于系统需求，如灵活性、安全性、复杂度和规模。</p>
<p dir="auto">几种主要模型的分析。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="sm">模型名称</th><th data-col-size="lg">全称</th><th data-col-size="xl">核心原理</th><th data-col-size="md">优点</th><th data-col-size="md">缺点</th><th data-col-size="lg">典型使用场景</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">DAC</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Discretionary Access Control (自主访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">用户（资源所有者）自行决定谁能访问其资源，通常基于访问控制列表 (ACL)。例如，文件所有者设置权限。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">灵活性高，用户自主管理；易于实现。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">安全性低，易受恶意用户影响（如病毒传播）；不适合高安全环境。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">个人文件系统（如Windows NTFS、Unix文件权限）；小型协作工具。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">MAC</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Mandatory Access Control (强制访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">系统强制执行基于标签的安全策略（如机密级别：公开、秘密、绝密）。主体和客体都有标签，访问需匹配规则。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">高安全性，防止信息泄露；适合多级安全。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">灵活性差，用户无法 override；管理复杂。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">军事/政府系统（如SELinux、AppArmor）；高保密环境如银行核心系统。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">RBAC</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Role-Based Access Control (基于角色的访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">用户分配角色，角色绑定权限。权限不直接赋给用户，而是通过角色间接管理。支持角色继承和会话。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">易于管理大规模用户；符合最小权限原则；便于审计。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">角色爆炸问题（太多角色）；静态，不易处理动态上下文。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">企业应用（如ERP系统、HR软件）；云平台（如AWS IAM角色）。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">ABAC</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Attribute-Based Access Control (基于属性的访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">基于主体、客体、环境和操作的属性（如用户部门、时间、位置）动态评估策略。通常用XACML语言定义规则。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">高度灵活，支持动态决策；细粒度控制。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">复杂，实现和性能开销大；策略管理困难。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">云服务（如Azure AD）；IoT系统；需要上下文感知的场景如远程访问。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">Rule-Based</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Rule-Based Access Control (基于规则的访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">定义一组规则（如IP过滤、时间限制），访问请求匹配规则通过。常与防火墙结合。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">简单直接；易于自动化。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">规则冲突可能；不适合复杂权限。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">网络防火墙（如iptables）；API网关（如Kong）。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="sm">Capability-Based</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">Capability-Based Access Control (基于能力的访问控制)</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">用户持有“能力”（token-like），能力直接授予对特定资源的访问权，无需检查所有者。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">高效，减少中央检查；支持分布式系统。</td>
<td data-col-size="md">能力泄露风险；撤销困难。</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">操作系统（如Capsicum in FreeBSD）；分布式文件系统（如Google's Spanner）。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 dir="auto">2. 详细分析</h3>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>DAC的使用</strong>：在日常开发中，常用于文件共享系统。实现示例：在Python中使用os.chmod设置文件权限。但在多用户环境中，易导致权限滥用，因此常与审计日志结合。</li>
<li><strong>MAC的使用</strong>：适用于严格分级系统，如在Linux上启用SELinux。策略文件定义标签，系统内核强制执行。缺点是调试复杂，但可防止越权（如root用户也受限）。</li>
<li><strong>RBAC的使用</strong>：最流行模型。在数据库中存储用户-角色-权限表。示例：在Spring Security中配置@PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")。扩展时可添加角色层次（如admin继承user）。</li>
<li><strong>ABAC的使用</strong>：现代趋势，支持AI驱动决策。使用Policy Decision Point (PDP)评估属性。示例：在OAuth2中结合JWT token的claims进行属性检查。适合微服务架构，但需优化规则引擎以避免延迟。</li>
<li><strong>混合模型</strong>：实际项目中常混合使用，如RBAC+ABAC（称为RBAC扩展），角色提供粗粒度，属性提供细粒度。示例：AWS使用角色（RBAC）+条件键（ABAC）。</li>
</ul>
<h3 dir="auto">3. 实施建议</h3>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>选择依据</strong>：小型系统用DAC/RBAC；高安全用MAC/ABAC；动态环境用ABAC。</li>
<li><strong>最佳实践</strong>：遵循最小权限原则（Least Privilege）；定期审计权限；使用工具如Open Policy Agent (OPA)统一管理多模型。</li>
<li><strong>潜在风险</strong>：权限膨胀（权限过多导致漏洞）；配置错误（如默认全开权限）。</li>
<li><strong>工具推荐</strong>：身份管理 - Keycloak/OAuth；策略引擎 - OPA；监控 - ELK Stack。</li>
</ul>
<h3 dir="auto">4.&nbsp;权限模型的表格设计</h3>
<ul>
<li dir="auto">
<h4>DAC（自主访问控制） → 基于 ACL（Access Control List）</h4>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">　　　　核心思想：每个资源（对象）拥有自己的权限列表，由资源拥有者决定谁能访问。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="md">表名</th><th data-col-size="lg">说明</th><th data-col-size="xl">主要字段</th><th data-col-size="md">关系说明</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="md"><strong>resources</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">资源表（文件、文章、记录等）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, owner_id, name, type...</td>
<td data-col-size="md">-</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="md"><strong>acls</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">访问控制列表（ACL）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, resource_id, subject_id（用户/组ID）, subject_type（user/group）, permission（read/write/execute/delete）, granted_by（授予者）</td>
<td data-col-size="md">多对一关联 resource</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE resources (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    owner_id BIGINT NOT NULL,           </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 资源拥有者（用户ID）</span>
    name VARCHAR(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">type</span> ENUM(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">file</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">post</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">record</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE acls (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    resource_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    subject_id BIGINT NOT NULL,         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户ID 或 组ID</span>
    subject_type ENUM(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">group</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    permission ENUM(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">read</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">write</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">execute</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">delete</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">all</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    granted_by BIGINT,                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 谁授予的权限（可选，用于审计）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>
<h4 dir="auto">RBAC（基于角色的访问控制） → 最常用模型</h4>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">　　　　核心思想：用户 → 角色 → 权限</p>
<p dir="auto">　　</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="lg">表名</th><th data-col-size="lg">说明</th><th data-col-size="xl">主要字段</th><th data-col-size="sm">关系说明</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>users</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">用户表</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, username...</td>
<td data-col-size="sm">-</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>roles</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">角色表</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, name, description</td>
<td data-col-size="sm">-</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>permissions</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">权限表（细粒度操作）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, code（唯一标识，如 user:view）, name, resource, action</td>
<td data-col-size="sm">-</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>user_roles</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">用户-角色关联（多对多）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">user_id, role_id</td>
<td data-col-size="sm">多对多</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>role_permissions</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="lg">角色-权限关联（多对多）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">role_id, permission_id</td>
<td data-col-size="sm">多对多</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE roles (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);

CREATE TABLE permissions (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    code VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>) UNIQUE NOT NULL,   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如 user:view, post:delete</span>
    name VARCHAR(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    resource VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    action VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    role_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id)
);

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
    role_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    permission_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES roles(id),
    FOREIGN KEY (permission_id) REFERENCES permissions(id)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>
<h4 dir="auto">ABAC（基于属性的访问控制） → 最灵活但最复杂</h4>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">　　　　核心思想：不依赖固定角色，而是根据<strong>主体属性 + 客体属性 + 环境属性 + 操作</strong>动态评估。</p>
<p dir="auto">　　　　常见实现方式有两种：</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li style="list-style-type: none">
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none">
<ul>
<li><strong>策略表 + 属性表</strong>（纯数据库实现，较重）</li>
<li><strong>外部策略引擎</strong>（如 OPA、Casbin）+ 数据库只存属性</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="lg">表名</th><th data-col-size="md">说明</th><th data-col-size="lg">主要字段</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>attributes</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">属性定义表</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">id, name, type（user/object/environment）, description</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>user_attributes</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">用户属性值</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">user_id, attribute_id, value</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>object_attributes</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">资源属性值</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">object_id, object_type, attribute_id, value</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>policies</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">策略表（核心）</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">id, name, effect（allow/deny）, description</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>policy_rules</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">策略规则（一条策略可有多条规则）</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">policy_id, attribute_id, operator（=,&gt;,in等）, value</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>policy_actions</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">策略允许的操作</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">policy_id, action（read/write/delete）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>policy_targets</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">策略适用的资源范围</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">policy_id, resource_type, resource_id（可选）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE attributes (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    category ENUM(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">subject</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">resource</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">environment</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">action</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);

CREATE TABLE user_attributes (
    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    attribute_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    value VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, attribute_id)
);

CREATE TABLE object_attributes (
    object_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    object_type VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    attribute_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    value VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (object_id, object_type, attribute_id)
);

CREATE TABLE policies (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    effect ENUM(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">allow</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">deny</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL
);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 规则示例：部门=销售 且 时间在工作日 且 操作=read</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE policy_conditions (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    policy_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    attribute_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    operator ENUM(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&gt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">contains</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
    value VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>
<h4 dir="auto">MAC（强制访问控制） → 高安全场景</h4>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">　　　　核心思想：系统强制基于<strong>安全标签</strong>（如机密级别：公开、内部、秘密、绝密）决定访问。</p>
<p dir="auto">　　　　</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="lg">表名</th><th data-col-size="md">说明</th><th data-col-size="xl">主要字段</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>security_levels</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">安全级别定义</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, name（UNCLASSIFIED, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET, TOP_SECRET）, level_value（数字越大越密）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>users</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">用户表（扩展）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">... + clearance_level_id（许可级别）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>objects</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">资源表（扩展）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">... + classification_level_id（分类级别） + compartments（可选：项目A、项目B等）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>compartments</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">范畴/类别（需知原则）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, name</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>object_compartments</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">资源所属范畴（多对多）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">object_id, compartment_id</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p dir="auto">　　　　</p>
<p dir="auto"><strong>　　　　访问规则示例</strong>（Bell-LaPadula模型）：</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li style="list-style-type: none">
<ul>
<li style="list-style-type: none">
<ul>
<li>读：主体许可级别 ≥ 客体分类级别 且 主体范畴包含客体所有范畴</li>
<li>写：主体许可级别 ≤ 客体分类级别 且 主体范畴 ⊆ 客体范畴</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE security_levels (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    level_value INT NOT NULL  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 数字越大越密</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

CREATE TABLE compartments (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) UNIQUE NOT NULL
);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 用户许可级别（clearance）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ALTER TABLE users ADD clearance_level_id INT REFERENCES security_levels(id);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 资源分类级别</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ALTER TABLE objects ADD classification_level_id INT REFERENCES security_levels(id);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 资源所属范畴（多对多）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE object_compartments (
    object_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    compartment_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (object_id, compartment_id)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<ul>
<li>
<h4 dir="auto">Capability-Based（基于能力的访问控制）</h4>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">　　　　核心思想：用户持有“能力令牌”（Capability），令牌直接指向资源+操作，无需查中央权限表。</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="lg">表名</th><th data-col-size="md">说明</th><th data-col-size="xl">主要字段</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>capabilities</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">能力令牌表</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">id, token（唯一字符串或UUID）, user_id, resource_id, resource_type, permissions（JSON或多字段）, expires_at, revoked</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>capability_scopes</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="md">能力作用范围（可选）</td>
<td data-col-size="xl">capability_id, scope（特定记录ID等）</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p dir="auto">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">CREATE TABLE capabilities (
    id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    token VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">255</span>) UNIQUE NOT NULL,     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> JWT 或 UUID</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    resource_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    resource_type VARCHAR(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) NOT NULL,
    permissions JSON NOT NULL,              </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ["read","write"]</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    expires_at TIMESTAMP,
    revoked BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>总结：</h3>
<p>　　</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th data-col-size="lg">模型</th><th data-col-size="xl">推荐场景</th><th data-col-size="lg">表数量</th><th data-col-size="xs">复杂度</th><th data-col-size="md">灵活性</th><th data-col-size="xs">性能</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>DAC</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="xl">文件系统、个人资源共享</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">2-3</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">低</td>
<td data-col-size="md">高</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>RBAC</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="xl">企业级SaaS、中后台系统</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">4-6</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">中</td>
<td data-col-size="md">中高</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>ABAC</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="xl">云服务、IoT、需要上下文的场景</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">6+</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">高</td>
<td data-col-size="md">极高</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">中</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>MAC</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="xl">军事、政府、高保密系统</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">4-6</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">中高</td>
<td data-col-size="md">低</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">高</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-col-size="lg"><strong>CapBAC</strong></td>
<td data-col-size="xl">分布式系统、微服务、临时授权</td>
<td data-col-size="lg">2-4</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">中</td>
<td data-col-size="md">高</td>
<td data-col-size="xs">高</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
